featuredItem.name: GitHub Copilot Radar
featuredItem.shortDescription: Continuous architectural analysis and plain-English PR diff summaries directly in your workflow.
featuredItem.fullDescription: Copilot Radar monitors commits across monorepos, predicts breaking API changes, and drafts plain-English explanations for PR reviewers before code review begins.

items.name: Docker Build & Push
items.shortDescription: Build and push Docker container images with Buildx and multi-platform cache support.
items.fullDescription: Official GitHub Action to build and push Docker images using Buildx with full BuildKit caching options.

items.name: CodeQL Semantic Analysis
items.shortDescription: Discover zero-day vulnerabilities and SQL injection attacks using semantic code queries.
items.fullDescription: Industry-standard semantic AST code analysis engine finding vulnerabilities before code merges.

items.name: Prettier Action Pro
items.shortDescription: Automatically check and apply opinionated code formatting on PR commits.
items.fullDescription: Runs Prettier on pull requests and commits fixes automatically or comments on formatting errors.

items.name: Sentry Release Health
items.shortDescription: Track deployments, notify developers of regressions, and associate stack traces to commits.
items.fullDescription: Real-time error tracking and crash reporting correlated with GitHub commits and pull requests.

items.name: Tailwind Design Inspector
items.shortDescription: Audits PRs for design token alignment and generates accessible color contrast recommendations.
items.fullDescription: Real-time CSS utility linter that flags arbitrary values and suggests token-compliant classes.

items.name: Prisma Schema Guard
items.shortDescription: Validates schema changes against production Postgres databases to detect data loss risks.
items.fullDescription: Automates database migration testing in ephemeral environments on every pull request.
